description: Scorpio decan 3 (November 12 to November 21): personality, love, work and growth, with the Moon as sub-ruler of the third ten degrees of Scorpio.
answer: In Western astrology, the third decan of Scorpio covers 20° to 29° of the sign, roughly November 12 to November 21, with the Moon as its sub-ruler beside Pluto. It is read as protective loyalty and emotional memory wrapped around a steel core. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Scorpio decan 3 personality
paragraphs: The final decan of Scorpio, from 20 to 29 degrees, takes the Moon as sub-ruler. The Moon governs Cancer, so this stretch blends Scorpio's depth with a strong instinct to nurture and protect. People born here are often described as fiercely loyal to their inner circle, with an almost tribal sense of who belongs. Home, family and chosen kin carry tremendous weight. They tend to remember emotional details for years: who showed up, who did not, what was said at a difficult moment. Outwardly they may appear composed, but beneath that surface the feelings move in tides, rising and falling with surprising speed.

The lunar influence makes this decan more openly caring than the first two, though still selective about whom it lets in. Once someone is inside the circle, the protection is total; they may be the person who drops everything in a crisis and stays long after others have gone home. The Moon also sharpens sensitivity to atmosphere and to the past, so old hurts can linger. Moodiness and defensive withdrawal are possible when they feel unappreciated. Yet the combination of Scorpio's endurance with lunar tenderness creates a rare kind of emotional reliability, the steady presence that people come to depend upon in hard seasons.

sections.heading: Scorpio decan 3 in love and at work
paragraphs: In love, the third decan of Scorpio is often deeply nurturing, building a sense of home around the people it cares for. Affection tends to be expressed through care: cooking, remembering, protecting, noticing when something is wrong. Feeling safe matters enormously, and they may need time before revealing their softer side. Hurt can turn into a long memory and a cool silence. Partners who acknowledge their feelings directly, without dismissing or rushing them, usually find them extraordinarily devoted. Learning to voice hurt early, before it settles into the shell, keeps their tender loyalty from curdling into resentment.

At work, the Moon's decan of Scorpio tends to shine in roles that combine care with resilience: nursing, early-years education, family support, hospitality, property, human resources, food and any field where people need to feel protected. They often become the emotional anchor of a team, the one colleagues confide in. Their instinct for what people need, paired with real tenacity, makes them effective under strain. The risk is taking workplace conflicts personally or over-functioning as everyone's protector. Clear limits on how much emotional labour they absorb help them stay effective without quietly exhausting themselves.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Scorpio decan 3: what the Moon adds
paragraphs: The third decan covers 20° to 29° of Scorpio, which in most years means birthdays from November 12 to November 21. Its sub-ruler, the Moon, comes from Cancer, the last water sign after Scorpio, so this decan borrows a little of Cancer's character while staying Scorpio at heart. The other two decans of Scorpio belong to Pluto (decan 1) and Neptune (decan 2). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

The Moon adds feeling, memory and responsiveness. Its decans are usually described as more intuitive and more attached to home, family and familiar rhythms, quick to sense a mood in the room and slower to let go of old loyalties. Lunar decans are often linked with caretaking, nostalgia and changeable moods, and their usual lesson is to look after their own needs as carefully as other people's. Set against Scorpio's intensity, loyalty, perception and emotional depth, that Moon note shifts the emphasis without changing the sign underneath.

sections.heading: Growth for Scorpio decan 3
paragraphs: Growth for this decan often involves letting the past be the past. Their memory for emotional detail is a gift, yet holding on to every slight can make the present heavier than it needs to be. Journaling, or simply naming a feeling aloud to someone trusted, can help moods pass through rather than settle. It can also help to receive care as readily as they give it, since many natives are far better at protecting others than at asking for support. When they extend the same gentleness inwards, their loyalty tends to feel nourishing for everyone, themselves included.

Within Scorpio, decan 1 leans towards depth, focus and transformation at their most concentrated and decan 2 leans towards intensity softened into intuition, imagination and quiet compassion. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: Why is the Moon the sub-ruler of Scorpio's third decan?
faq.answer: Under the triplicity scheme, the third decan borrows the ruler of the third sign in the same element. For water signs the order runs Scorpio, Pisces, Cancer, and the Moon governs Cancer. That gives this decan a protective, nurturing and emotionally sensitive tone.

faq.question: What are the dates of Scorpio decan 3?
faq.answer: In most years November 12 to November 21, the days when the Sun is between 20° and 29° of Scorpio. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Scorpio decan 3?
faq.answer: The Moon. In the triplicity system each water sign's decans take the rulers of the water signs in order, starting with Scorpio's own ruler, Pluto.
